# A parameter that leaks only into another parameter's pointee keeps
# the caller's object on the stack: the precision applies to Go
# packages under GOEXPERIMENT=logosescape and always under logos.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
go build -o $WORK/off$GOEXE ./call
exec $WORK/off$GOEXE
stdout '^allocs [1-9][0-9]*$'
stdout '^sink 1$'
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosescape
go build -o $WORK/on$GOEXE ./call
exec $WORK/on$GOEXE
stdout '^allocs 0$'
stdout '^sink 1$'
logos build -o $WORK/logos$GOEXE ./call
exec $WORK/logos$GOEXE
stdout '^allocs 0$'
stdout '^sink 1$'
env GOEXPERIMENT=

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/pointeego

go 1.27

-- m/p.go --
package p

type node struct {
	next *node
	v    int
}

//go:noinline
func linkThrough(p, q *node) {
	p.next = q
}

var Sink int

//go:noinline
func Make() {
	var y node
	x := &node{v: 1}
	linkThrough(&y, x)
	Sink = x.v + y.v
}

-- m/call/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	p "example.com/pointeego"
)

func main() {
	a := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() { p.Make() })
	fmt.Println("allocs", a)
	fmt.Println("sink", p.Sink)
}
